theme: A clear calendar and a stack of trip logistics to close before Croatia.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar to work around today, Dan - the girls' passport appointment this morning was the one fixed point. That leaves the afternoon as the cleanest run this week at the Croatia and Orlando bookings before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Disney tickets for Orlando
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 26-27 Disney task is p1 and due today. Rooms are handled by the villa, so tickets for your six are the piece with the hard wall now - check whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and the transfers
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 tasks are past due: the single Sept 19 night in Cavtat plus the Komolac-to-Cavtat and early-Sunday airport transfers. The charter has no connectivity, so it all has to be booked from land before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Close the Sept 20-22 St Pete window
needsAttention.detail: The two nights between landing from Croatia and the Orlando villa are still unbooked - the last open gap in the run. Worth also confirming the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Croatia ticket shows zero checked bags. Pull it up on Eurowings Discover's site with the record locator, confirm the allowance there, and buy bags online now rather than at the airport counter.

schedule.title: Passport appointments - all four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office, new books for each

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing balance due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks invoice 2170 for the Croatia course, $6,475, came in as a payment reminder - due before the Sept 12 start.

flagged.title: Japan board introduction is open
flagged.detail: The JOMON thread through Kerrie has gone quiet since you offered call times in July; Furuta's team was to coordinate, so a light nudge would move it.

flagged.title: Five sitter applications on Care.com
flagged.detail: Valerie, Sakhene, Wadlyne, Filia and one more replied to your posting - worth a scan when you're picking who to screen.

inbox.noise: The rest is Labor Day sale blasts, newsletters, a Liberty Mutual renewal notice, and furniture matches.
inbox.clear: Paul's welcome note to the sailing crew is a group message - nothing there is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: Late-August tomatoes and cucumbers are at their peak, so a cool composed salad is the easiest way to let them shine.

tasks.title: Call the dermatologist to book wart removal
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The morning ran on family errands - the girls' passport appointment at 9:30, with a round of calls stacked behind it.
Nothing on the calendar holds the afternoon, which makes it the clearest run at the trip bookings all week.
The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, so it's a full house tonight.
